inputs_source: stored: every role=input file is the committed array and is never redrawn. The gdn and rope inputs are the original torch.randn(generator=) draws, extracted from the first committed fixtures; the gate inputs are numpy default_rng draws. Only the goldens are recomputed.

config_qwen35_2b_base.json.note: Qwen3.5-2B-Base's real text config, the shape source for tests that need the 2B's dimensions

qwen35_gates_a.npy.note: numpy default_rng stream, drawn once by --init-gate-inputs

qwen35_gates_a_log.npy.note: numpy default_rng stream, drawn once by --init-gate-inputs

qwen35_gates_b.npy.note: numpy default_rng stream, drawn once by --init-gate-inputs

qwen35_gates_beta.npy.note: captured from Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet.forward (g = -exp(A_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias); beta = sigmoid(b)): the golden of qwen35_gdn_gates_f32

qwen35_gates_dt_bias.npy.note: numpy default_rng stream, drawn once by --init-gate-inputs

qwen35_gates_g.npy.note: captured from Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet.forward (g = -exp(A_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias); beta = sigmoid(b)): the golden of qwen35_gdn_gates_f32
